en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from hi sfather, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>

having said regarding a contracted slave girl, her master copulated with her. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘A similar dower would be returned to her, and she would work regarding her price. So if she was frustrated (from paying), so she is from the mothers of the children’.
